main_text.p: quid, & quid non pugnet cum jure Divino, illud imprimis commendet observandum & arctè tenendum; Deo potius esse obtemperan-dum quàm hominibus. Cum, inquam, tam latè pateat officium Pastorum Evangelicorum; altrinsecus Deus in terris, omnem personam, omnes lites, leges, dicenda, agenda, de quacumque re aut negotio, in quocunque loco, tempore & coetu hominum, judicio, quod præcipit, mandat, jubet, cogit & punit, subjecerit cognitioni & imperio Magistratus, non Ecclesiastici (cujus altum est silentium in sacro codice) sed civilis & Politici; inde conficitur Papam, quatenus exercet imperium extra territorium suum in Reges & populos, catenus imperium terrenum Jurisdictionemque civilem & Politicam exercere, consimilem potestati Magistratûs; nec nisi ad fucum faciendum (& ne dispalescat imperium Papæ terrenum) fucari & obduci, vocabulis Ecclesiastici & Spiritualis.
main_text.head: CAPUT

page.notes: The heading "CAPUT" is printed without a number; the caput attribute is therefore given as 4 only by inference from the running title, which is uncertain. Long s rendered as s throughout. The page contains ink specks and show-through only otherwise; the "Digitized by Google" credit is omitted.
